text: Hyprland config is Lua: o.bind, hl.unbind, hl.monitor, o.window, o.launch_on_start. Never write hyprlang .conf syntax into the .lua files.
When rebinding a key already bound, add hl.unbind("KEYS") before o.bind and tell the user the previous binding.
Customize stock themes via a same-slug overlay in ~/.config/omarchy/themes/<slug>/ holding only changed files, then omarchy theme set.
Built-in bar widgets: omarchy plugin clone omarchy.<name>, then edit ~/.config/omarchy/plugins/<username>.<name>/; never edit $OMARCHY_PATH/shell/plugins.
Window-rule syntax changes between Hyprland versions; mirror $OMARCHY_PATH/default/hypr/windows.lua rather than memory.
Run omarchy debug only with --no-sudo --print; omarchy refresh/reinstall need user confirmation first.
